annotations.title: EVE Frontier Multi-Hop Smart Gate Fuel & Toll Route Planner

description: Calculates optimal stargate jump routes between EVE Frontier solar systems minimizing gigajoule fuel consumption, LUX gate tolls, or jump count. Use when plotting a ship transit path across public and tribe-restricted Smart Gates; for identifying multi-system commodity arbitrage trade loops across Smart Storage Units, use find_eve_ssu_arbitrage instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'origin_system' ('destination_system' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

optimize_for.description: Routing objective function weighting fuel burn vs tolls; defaults to 'lowest_fuel' when omitted.

name: plan_eve_gate_route

estimated_fuel_burn_gj.description: Total ship fuel consumption in gigajoules (GJ) across the route.

optimal_hops.description: Total number of stargate jumps along the selected path.

total_gate_tolls_lux.description: Cumulative Smart Gate transit tolls required in LUX.

waypoints.description: Ordered list of solar systems and Lagrange Smart Gates traversed.
